messages.subject: Meet and Analyze Data, 2/8
parts:
Hi all,

we will be having a Meet and Analyze Data session from 3:15pm-5:30pm
on Wed, 2/8, in the Bennett Room
(www.vetmed.ucdavis.edu/ccah/ccah-secure/bennett-conf-room.cfm). Hope
to see you there!

—

If you think you are going to join us, please let us know --

https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSeUW5QS55uDwDpusGYerY542D_tQubkmPMtUKlGdbmoSWfSSQ/viewform
—

Also! We have a new Slack channel on the ucdavis Slack app! Go to
‘ucdavis.slack.edu’ and sign up, then join channel #maddibs. We’re
happy to help you do that if you come this week, of course ;).

Cheers,
Luiz Irber
